qe: Who is the 'Ex-Officio Chairman' of the NITI Aayog?
qh: नीति आयोग का 'पदेन अध्यक्ष' कौन होता है?
e: NITI Aayog ka padena adhyaksh yaani ex-officio chairman desh ka pradhanmantri hota hai, isliye yah pad usi ke paas rehta hai. Pehla vikalp pradhanmantri ko is pad par sahi darshata hai. aisa bandobast isliye kiya gaya ki niti banane wali sabse badi sanstha ke faisle sarkar ke sabse bade pratinidhi se hi juda rahe, isliye chairman ka pad pradhanmantri ke saath jood diya gaya. Vitta mantri, uparashtrapati tatha rashtrapati is sanstha ke sahi padena adhyaksh nahi hain, kyunki yah pad pradhanmantri ke saath jooda hua hai. Yah teeno pad anya samvaidhanik kaamon se jude hain. Exam point: NITI Aayog ka padena adhyaksh pradhanmantri tatha mukhya karyapalak adhikari usi ka hota hai.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Direct Tax' in India?
qh: भारत में इनमें से कौन सा एक 'प्रत्यक्ष कर' (Direct Tax) है?
e: Pratyaksh kar yaani direct tax wo hota hai jiska bojh vyakti khud apni kamai se uthata hai tatha aage nahi daal sakta, isliye Income Tax yaani aaykar isi jati ka udaharan hai. Pehla vikalp aaykar ko sahi gat mein rakhta hai. Is jati ki pahchan yah hai ki bhugtan karne wale tatha bojh uthane wale ek hi hote hain, isliye aaykar seedha vyakti ki kamai se kata jaata hai. Seema shulk, abhkari shulk tatha GST saaman tatha sevaon ki bikri se jude kar hain isliye apratyaksh jaati ke hain, kyunki inka bojh grahak tak jaata hai. Yah teeno vikalp apratyaksh kar ke udaharan hain. Exam point: pratyaksh kar ka bojh nahi sarakta tatha apratyaksh kar sadhan ke saath aage badhta hai.

qe: The 'Laffer Curve' shows the relationship between:
qh: 'लैफ़र कर्व' किसके बीच संबंध दर्शाता है?
e: Laffer Curve yaani Laffer ka vakr kar ki dar tatha kar ki kul vasooli ke beech ka rishta dikhata hai, isliye yah batata hai ki ek hadd ke baad dar badhane se sarkar ki kamai ghatne lagti hai. Pehla vikalp isi jodi ko sahi jodta hai. Is rishte ka kaaran yah hai ki bahut ooncha kar ka dar logon ko kaam tatha vyapar se hata deta hai tatha chori badha deta hai, isliye sarkari khazana khali hota jaata hai. GNP tatha GDP ka antar, maang tatha aapurti ka jod tatha mehngai tatha beroonzmari ka sambandh is vakr ke sahi jodi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya aarthik rishton ke jode hain. Exam point: kar ki dar badhne par shuru mein vasooli badhti hai, ek na ek hadd ke baad ghatne lagti hai.

qe: The 'Base Year' for calculating GDP in India is currently:
qh: भारत में GDP की गणना के लिए 'आधार वर्ष' वर्तमान में क्या है?
e: Bharat mein kul gharelu utpad yaani GDP nikaalne ka aadhar varsh abhi 2011-12 hai, isliye usi saal ki keematein tatha dhaancha tulna ka paimana banta hai. Teesra vikalp isi aadhar varsh ko sahi uthata hai. Aadhar varsh ko samay-samay par badalne ka kaaran yah hai ki aarthik dhaancha tatha kharche ka chalan purana pad jaata hai, isliye tulna theek rakhne ke liye naya varsh tay karna padta hai. 2004-05, 2010-11 tatha 2018-19 is samay GDP ke aadhar varsh nahi hain, kyunki maujooda ginti 2011-12 par ho rahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp anya saalon ke hain. Exam point: GDP ka aaj ka aadhar varsh 2011-12 hai tatha isi saal ki keematon par aakde nikale jaate hain.

qe: Which sector is the 'Backbone' of Bihar's economy?
qh: बिहार की अर्थव्यवस्था की 'रीढ़' कौन सा क्षेत्र है?
e: Bihar ki arthvyavastha ki reedh kheti tatha usse jude kaam hain, kyunki gaon wale logon ka bada hissa kheti par nirbhar hai tatha yahin se rozgar milta hai. Teesra vikalp kheti ko sahi reedh batata hai. Yah sthiti isliye bani ki rajy mein kheti tatha pashupalan bahut bade paimana par hota hai, isliye kheti ke achhe-bure saal seedhe aam aadmi ki jeb par asar daalte hain. Karkhane, seva kshetra tatha khanan ke kaam Bihar mein hain par kheti ki tarah inka dayra bada nahi hai, isliye ye reedh nahi kehlate. Yah teeno vikalp rajy ke sahi aadhar nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar ki arthvyavastha ki reedh kheti hai tatha isi par sabse zyada log nirbhar hain.

qe: Devaluation of currency usually leads to:
qh: मुद्रा के अवमूल्यन (Devaluation) से आमतौर पर क्या होता है?
e: Devaluation yaani sarkar dwara apni currency ki keemat jaan-boojh kar kam karne se baahar ke deshon ke liye saaman sasta pad jaata hai, isliye niryat tatha niryaatak mehngi hote hain. Doosra vikalp saste niryat ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah asar isliye hota hai ki videshi khareedar ko ek hi dollar ke badle zyada desi paisa milta hai, isliye wahi samaan kam videshi paise mein mil jaata hai tatha niryat badhti hai. Saste aayatan, niryat mein kami tatha videshi karz ka bakaya badhna is kadam ke sahi natije nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp ulta ya alag natija dikhate hain. Exam point: avmulyan se niryat sasta tatha aayatan mehnga ho jaata hai tatha videshi karz mehnga padta hai.

qe: What is 'Hidden Unemployment' (Disguised Unemployment)?
qh: 'प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी' (Disguised Unemployment) क्या है?
e: Disguised Unemployment yaani prachhann beroonzmari aisi haalat hai jismein zarurat se zyada log ek hi kaam par lage hote hain, isliye kisi ek ko hataane se bhi kaam ka koi nuksan nahi hota. Doosra vikalp zarurat se zyada logon ko sahi pehchanta hai. Yah sthiti mukhya roop se kheti mein dikhti hai kyunki parivar ke saare sadasya apni zameen par kaam karne pahunch jaate hain, isliye sankhya badhti hai par utpadan wahi rehta hai. Ashtheayi beroonzmari, padhe-likhe logon ko kaam na milna tatha bazaar mein kaam ke mauke na hona is beroonzmari ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya kaarano se bani beroonzmari hain. Exam point: prachhann beroonzmari mein zarurat se zyada haath kaam par rehte hain tatha utpadan par koi asar nahi padta.

qe: The concept of 'Mixed Economy' means:
qh: 'मिश्रित अर्थव्यवस्था' (Mixed Economy) की अवधारणा का अर्थ है:
e: Mixed Economy yaani mishrit arthvyavastha ka matlab hai ki niji tatha sarkari dono kshetra saath-saath kaam karte hain, isliye faisle bazaar tatha sarkari niyojan dono se hote hain. Pehla vikalp dono kshetron ke saath hone ko sahi bayaan karta hai. Yah tarika isliye apnaya gaya ki keval bazaar par chhodne se barabari bigadti hai tatha keval sarkar se kaam dheema chalta hai, isliye dono ko saath rakha jaata hai. Desi tatha videshi vyapar, kheti tatha udyog tatha ameer tatha gareeb is avdharna ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp khandan ke jode hain, arthvyavastha ke roop nahi. Exam point: bharat mishrit arthvyavastha hai, jismein sarkari tatha niji dono kshetra saath chalan karte hain.

qe: What is the full form of 'GNP' in Economics?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में 'GNP' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: GNP ka poora naam Gross National Product hai, isliye yah desh ke logon dwara saal bhar mein banaye gaye kapda maal tatha sevaon ka kul molya dikhata hai. chautha vikalp isi poore naam ko sahi likhta hai. GNP mein desh ke logon ki kamai jahan bhi ho shaamil hoti hai, isliye yah GDP se alag hota hai tatha ek desh ke saaman ke bahar ki kamai ko bhi jodta hai. Gross Net Product, General National Product tatha Government National Plan ka GNP se koi wabasta nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp gumraah karne wale naam hain. Exam point: GNP ka poora naam Gross National Product hai tatha ismein desh ke logon ki videsh se mili kamai bhi jodti hai.

qe: Which organization replaced the Planning Commission in 2015?
qh: 2015 में किस संगठन ने योजना आयोग का स्थान लिया?
e: Yojna ayog ki jagah 2015 mein NITI Aayog yaani rastriya bharat parivartan sansthan ne li, isliye ab yahi topi sanstha niti banane ke liye salah deti hai. Chautha vikalp isi sanstha ko sahi chunta hai. Naya naam tatha naya dhaancha isliye laya gaya ki purani sanstha keval upar se aadesh deti thi, isliye ab rajy tatha anya hissedaaron ko saath leke chalne wali sanstha bani. GST Council, RBI tatha Vitt Aayog yah jagah lene wali sansthaayein nahi hain, kyunki ye anya kaam dekhti hain. Yah teeno sansthaayein alag kaam ke dayre ki hain. Exam point: 2015 mein Yojna Aayog ki jagah NITI Aayog aayi tatha iska padena adhyaksh pradhanmantri hota hai.

qe: Which sector contributes the most to India's GDP?
qh: भारत के GDP में किस क्षेत्र का योगदान सबसे अधिक है?
e: Bharat ke GDP mein sabse bada hissa seva kshetra ka hai, isliye bank, vyapar, parivahan tatha soochana jaise kaam desh ki aay ka aadha se zyada hissa banate hain. Chautha vikalp seva kshetra ko sahi sarvopari dikhata hai. Yah badha hissa isliye bana ki aazadi ke baad kheti ka hissa girta gaya tatha sevaon ka kaam tez badha, isliye rozgar tatha aay dono mein sevaon ka dabdaba barqarar hai. Udyog, kheti tatha khanan is bade hisse se kaafi peeche hain, isliye ye sarvopari kshetra nahi kehla sakte. Yah teeno vikalp seva kshetra se kam hisse wale hain. Exam point: GDP mein seva kshetra ka hissa sabse zyada hai tatha kheti ka hissa lagatar ghat raha hai.

qe: What is the full form of 'GST'?
qh: 'GST' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: GST ka poora naam Goods and Services Tax hai, isliye yah saaman tatha sevaon ki aapurti par lagne wala ek hi tarah ka sandarbh kar hai. Pehla vikalp yahi poora naam theek likhta hai. Ek naam ke neeche poora desh isliye laya gaya ki pehle rajya-dar-rajya alag-alag kar the, isliye ek jaisa kar lagane se vyapar ke raste khul gaye. Global Sales Tax, General Sales Tax tatha Government Service Tax keval milte-julte naam hain, asli poora naam nahi. Yah teeno vikalp naam ke khandan hain. Exam point: GST yaani Goods and Services Tax tatha iska gathan 101ve sanvidhan sanshodhan se hua.

qe: Which economic sector is the largest contributor to Bihar's GSDP?
qh: बिहार की 'जीएसडीपी' (GSDP) में सबसे अधिक योगदान किस आर्थिक क्षेत्र का है?
e: Bihar ki GSDP yaani kul rajya gharelu utpad mein sabse bada hissa teesre kshetra ka hai, tatha is khand mein vyapar, parivahan, banking tatha soochana jaise kaam aate hain. Doosra vikalp isi kshetra ko sahi paimana batata hai. Yah pehchan isliye banti hai ki kheti tatha khanan kachche maal wale kaam hain tatha karkhane maal banate hain, jabki bachi hui sabhi sevaayein isi khand mein aati hain. Kheti prathmik kshetra mein, karkhane dvitiyak kshetra mein tatha soochana chaturth kshetra ke kaam mein ginne jaate hain, isliye ye sahi paimana nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya khandon ke udaharan hain. Exam point: rajya ki GSDP mein teesre kshetra ka hissa sabse bada hai tatha vyapar-parivahan jaise kaam isi khand ke hain.

qe: Which sector of the Indian economy contributes the most to the 'Gross Domestic Product' (GDP)?
qh: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था का कौन सा क्षेत्र 'सकल घरेलू उत्पाद' (GDP) में सबसे अधिक योगदान देता है?
e: Bharat ke GDP mein sabse zyada yogdaan teesre kshetra yaani sevaon ka hai, kyunki isi khand ki kamai desh ki kul aay ka aadha hissa banati hai. Chautha vikalp isi khand ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah sthiti isliye bani ki aazadi ke baad vyapar, banking, soochana tatha anya sevaon ka kaam sabse tez badha, isliye ab yahi desh ki aay ka sabse bada stambh hai. Dvitiyak kshetra, prathmik kshetra tatha chaturth kshetra is sabse bade hisse se bahut peeche hain, isliye ye sarvopari nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp alag khandon ke hain. Exam point: GDP mein sabse zyada yogdaan teesre kshetra tatha sevaon ka hai.

qe: Which mode of transport is considered the most convenient for door-to-door service and can negotiate higher gradients of slopes like the Himalayas?
qh: किस परिवहन माध्यम को घर-घर सेवा के लिए सबसे सुविधाजनक माना जाता है और यह हिमालय जैसी ऊँची ढलानों पर भी बनाया जा सकता है?
e: Sadak marg yaani roadways hi aisa sadhan hai jo ghar ke dwar tak pahunchta hai tatha oonchi dhaalon par bhi banaya ja sakta hai, isliye pahadi ilaakon mein yahi sabse suvidhajanak mana jaata hai. Chautha vikalp sadak marg ko sahi chunta hai. Is sadhan ki suvidha isliye badi hai ki ise banane mein kam kharch lagta hai tatha kisi bhi dhaalan par seedhi chadhai ki zarurat nahi padti, isliye yah durgam jagahon tak bhi pahunch jaata hai. Hawai marg, pipeline tatha rail marg durgam dhaalon par pahunchne tatha ghar tak seedha rasta dene mein is tarah kaam nahi karte. Yah teeno vikalp alag kharche tatha raaste ke hain. Exam point: ghar-ghar seva tatha oonchi dhaalon ke liye sabse upyukt sadhan sadak marg hi hai.

qe: Which organization is responsible for maintaining 'National Highways' (NH) in India?
qh: भारत में 'राष्ट्रीय राजमार्गों' (NH) के रखरखाव के लिए कौन सा संगठन जिम्मेदार है?
e: Bharat mein rastriya rajmargon ke rakharakhav tatha nirman ki kendriya jimmedari kendriya lok nirman vibhag yaani CPWD ke paas rakhi gayi hai, isliye yah sahi sanstha hai. Teesra vikalp isi vibhag ko chunta hai. Yah kaam is vibhag ke paas isliye aaya ki kendriya dhaanche banane tatha unhe chalu rakhne ki dal tatha anubhav isi ke paas hai, isliye badi pariyojnaon ka bhar yahi uthata hai. Seema Sadak Sangathan seema wale ilaakon ke raston par, jila parishad gaon ke raston par tatha rajya lok nirman vibhag rajy ke raston par kaam karte hain. Yah teeno vikalp alag sadkon ke kaam dekhte hain. Exam point: kendriya star par CPWD rajmargon tatha kendriya bhavanon ke nirman-rrakharakhav ka vibhag hai.

qe: What is the primary function of the 'PM Gati Shakti' scheme launched by the Government of India?
qh: भारत सरकार द्वारा शुरू की गई 'पीएम गति शक्ति' योजना का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: Integrated planning and execution of infrastructure projects for multi-modal connectivity
Providing free internet to all students
e: PM Gati Shakti yaani pradhanmantri gati shakti yojana ka mukhya kaam alag-alag vibhagon ki pariyojnaon ko milakar ek saath chalu karna hai, isliye rail, sadak, bandargah tatha hawaai addon ka jod banta hai. Teesra vikalp isi mel-jod wale kaam ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah yojana isliye zaroori hui ki pehle ek hi raste ko baar-baar khodne tatha alag-alag vibhagon ke kaam mein taalmel na hone se paisa tatha samay barbad hota tha. Mandir banana, keval ganga ki safai tatha sab vidyarthiyon ko free internet dena is yojana ke sahi kaam nahi hain, kyunki ye kisi ek vivag ki yojnaon ke hai. Yah teeno vikalp is yojana ke dayre se bahar hain. Exam point: PM Gati Shakti ka asli kaam multi-modal connectivity ke liye milijuli pariyojna tatha tez amal hai.

qe: Which mode of transport is the 'Cheapest' and most suitable for carrying heavy and bulky goods over long distances in an eco-friendly manner?
qh: पर्यावरण के अनुकूल तरीके से लंबी दूरी तक भारी और बड़ा सामान ले जाने के लिए सबसे 'सस्ता' और उपयुक्त परिवहन माध्यम कौन सा है?
e: Jal marg yaani waterways se bahut bhaari tatha bada samaan lambi doori tak sabse kam kharch mein pahunchta hai, isliye yah paryavaran ke liye bhi sabse narm sadhan hai. Pehla vikalp jal marg ko sahi vikalp thehrata hai. Jal marg ki sasti hona isliye hai ki ek hi nau kaafi maal ek saath dho sakti hai tatha raste mein baar-baar kharch nahi uthana padta, isliye eke pichhe laagat kam aati hai. Sadak marg, truck tatha hawaai marg par aisa bhari maal le jaane par kharch tatha pradushan dono zyada ban jate hain. Yah teeno vikalp bhaari samaan ke liye mehngai wale hain. Exam point: bhaari maal lambi doori ke liye sabse sasta tatha paryavaran-kook jal marg hota hai.

qe: Which 'Major Sea Port' was the first to be developed after independence to ease the volume of trade on Mumbai port?
qh: मुंबई बंदरगाह पर व्यापार के दबाव को कम करने के लिए स्वतंत्रता के बाद विकसित किया गया पहला 'प्रमुख समुद्री बंदरगाह' कौन सा था?
e: Mumbai bandargah par dabaav kam karne ke liye aazadi ke baad sabse pehle Kandla yaani Deendayal bandargah ka vikas kiya gaya, isliye yah swatantrata ke baad bana pehla bada samundar dvar hai. Pehla vikalp isi bandargah ko sahi batata hai. Yah jagah isliye chuni gayi ki gujarat ki khadi ko bade jahajon ke liye aasan pahunch milti hai, isliye uttar tatha pashchim bharat ka bhaar kandla ki taraf moda gaya. Paradip, Chennai tatha Vishakhapatnam baad ke samay ke bade bandargah kaam mein aaye, isliye pehla bada samundar dvar ye nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp swatantrata ke baad ke anya bandargah hain. Exam point: aazadi ke baad bana pehla bada bandargah Kandla hi tha, jise ab Deendayal bandargah kehte hain.

qe: What is the main objective of the 'Sagar Mala' project and the 'Sagarat Samridhi Yojana'?
qh: 'सागर माला' परियोजना और 'सागरत समृद्धि योजना' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Providing free air tickets to island residents
Modernization of ports and port-led development in coastal areas
Cleaning the deep oceans from plastic
e: Sagarmala parivotra tatha Sagartal samriddhi ke aayojanon ka mukhya lakshya bandargahon ka aadhunikikaran tatha taton par bandargah se judi badhotri hai, isliye samundari vyapar tatha rozgar dono badhte hain. Teesra vikalp isi lakshya ko sahi batata hai. Yah kaam isliye zaroori hai ki desh ka bada hissa samundar ke raaste se vyapar karta hai, isliye bandargah sasta tatha tez hone se poore desh ka dhanda sasta padta hai. Island ke logon ko free hawaai tikat, gaon mein naye school tatha samundar ki safai is pariyojna ka sahi maksad nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya yojnaon ke kaam hain. Exam point: Sagarmala tatha Sagartal samriddhi ka asli maksad bandargahon ka vikas tatha bandargah se judi badhotri hai.

qe: Which is the largest recipient of remittances in the world as mentioned in economics chapters?
qh: आर्थिक अध्यायों में बताए अनुसार विश्व में रेमिटेंस (प्रेषण) का सबसे बड़ा प्राप्तकर्ता कौन है?
e: Vishw mein remittance yaani pravasiyon dwara bheje gaye paise ka sabse bada praptkarta Bharat hai, isliye bahar kaam karne wale logon ka paisa desh ki aay mein bada yogdaan deta hai. Chautha vikalp Bharat ko sahi praptkarta batata hai. Yah pehla sthaan isliye bana ki khadi khadi deshon mein kaam karne wale bharteey bahut bade paimana par hain tatha ve apni kamai ka bada hissa gharon ko bhejte hain. Mexico, Philippines tatha China bhi bade praptkarta hain par inki rashi Bharat se kam hai, isliye ye sabse aage nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp Bharat se peeche hain. Exam point: remittance ka sabse bada praptkarta desh Bharat hai tatha yah vidheshi mudra ka bada srot hai.

qe: What does 'Currency Appreciation' of the Indian Rupee mean against the US Dollar?
qh: अमेरिकी डॉलर के मुकाबले भारतीय रुपये के 'अधिमूल्यन' (Appreciation) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: The Rupee becomes weaker and you need more rupees to buy one dollar
The Rupee becomes stronger and you need fewer rupees to buy one dollar
The government stops the use of dollars
e: Appreciation yaani rupaye ki keemat badhne ka matlab yah hai ki ek dollar khareedne ke liye pehle se kam rupaye dene padte hain, isliye rupaya majboot ho jaata hai. Teesra vikalp isi majbooti ko sahi sambhalta hai. Yah badlav isliye hota hai ki videshi niveshak tatha niryat bhatke paisa desh mein aata hai, isliye rupaye ki maang badhne se uski keemat oopar chali jaati hai. Rupay ka kamzor hona, sone ki keemat ka girna tatha dollar ka istemal band ho jaana is badhotri ke sahi matlab nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya halat bayaan karte hain. Exam point: rupaye ka adhimulyan yaani appreciation hone par ek dollar ke badle kam rupaye lagte hain tatha aayatan sasta padta hai.

qe: What is 'Currency Depreciation'?
qh: 'मुद्रा का अवमूल्यन' (Depreciation) क्या है?
o: A sudden fall in the stock market index
Decrease in the value of a currency in a floating exchange rate system due to market forces
Increase in the value of currency due to government order
e: Depreciation yaani girti vimay dar ki vyavastha mein currency ki keemat bazaar ki maang tatha aapurti se gir jaati hai, isliye yah sarkar ke aadesh se nahi balki bhaav ke dabaav se hoti hai. Doosra vikalp isi bazaar wale kaaran ko sahi batata hai. Yah girawat isliye hoti hai ki aayatan tatha videshi niweshan ke liye zyada dollar khareedne padte hain tatha niryat se kam paisa aata hai, isliye rupaye ki aapurti bazaar mein badh jaati hai. Bazaar ke soochakank ka achanak girna, naye note chhapna tatha sarkari aadesh se keemat badhna is ghatna ke sahi nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya ghatnaon se jude hain. Exam point: floating vyavastha mein bazaar ki maang-apurti se rupaye ki keemat girna hi depreciation kehlata hai.

qe: What is the 'Impossible Trinity' (Trilemma) faced by Central Banks?
qh: केंद्रीय बैंकों द्वारा सामना की जाने वाली 'इम्पॉसिबल ट्रिनिटी' (ट्रिलेमा) क्या है?
o: Simultaneously achieving Fixed Exchange Rate, Free Capital Flow, and Independent Monetary Policy
Controlling Gold, Silver, and Platinum prices
e: Impossible Trinity yaani asambhav tinta yah niyam batata hai ki koi desh ek hi samay par sthair vimay dar, khuli punji chal, tatha swatantra monetar neeti - teeno ko nahi pa sakta, isliye ushe ek chhodna padta hai. Doosra vikalp inhi teen chunavon ko sahi ginwata hai. Yah jhatka isliye rehta hai ki khuli punji chal ke saath sthair vimay dar rakhne par kendra ko beyaaj dar apne hisaab se badalne ki azaadi nahi rehti, isliye teenon ek saath sambhav nahi. Jansankhya-gareebi-pradushan, kar-sabsidi-karz tatha sone-chandi-platinum ki keematein is siddhant ke sahi talmel nahi hain. Yah teeno jode anya vishyon ke hain. Exam point: sthair vimay dar, khuli punji chal tatha swatantra monetar neeti - in teenon ko ek saath pana asambhav hai.

qe: The concept of 'Purchasing Power Parity' (PPP) is used to compare:
qh: 'परचेजिंग पावर पैरिटी' (PPP) की अवधारणा का उपयोग किसकी तुलना करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: The amount of gold reserves in the world
The relative value of currencies based on the cost of a common basket of goods in different countries
The number of banks in each nation
e: Purchasing Power Parity yaani kharid shakti samanta alag-alag deshon mein ek hi tokri ke saaman ki keemat ki tulna karke currencies ki asli keemat batati hai, isliye yah vimay dar ke saath-saath samaan ki keemat bhi dekhti hai. Doosra vikalp isi tulanatmak paimane ko theek thehrata hai. Yah kharid shakti wala tarika isliye kaam aata hai ki bazaar ke vimay dar mein cheezon ke daam ka antar chhup jaata hai, isliye PPP se kamai tatha kharche ki asli tulna saaf dikhti hai. Duniya mein sone ka bhandar, har desh ke bankon ki ginti tatha deshon ki aabadi is avdharna ke sahi paimane nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp anya aankdon ke hain. Exam point: PPP ek hi tokri ke samaan ke aadhar par currencies ki tulna karta hai tatha GDP tulna mein bhi kama aata hai.

qe: What does an increase in the 'Real Effective Exchange Rate' (REER) indicate for a country's exports?
qh: 'वास्तविक प्रभावी विनिमय दर' (REER) में वृद्धि किसी देश के निर्यात के लिए क्या संकेत देती है?
o: Increase in the volume of exports
Loss of trade competitiveness as exports become relatively more expensive
e: REER yaani vaastavik prabhavi vinimay dar badhne ka sanket yah hai ki niryat tatha aayatan ki keematon ka antar desh ke khilaf ja raha hai, isliye desi maal videsh mein mehnga padne lagta hai tatha vyapar ki takat ghatti hai. Chautha vikalp isi takat ke ghatne ko sahi dikhata hai. Yah sthiti isliye banti hai ki mehngai tatha anya jodon ke kaaran desi maal apni keel ki keemat se zyada mehnga dikhta hai, isliye khareedar doosre deshon ka maal chunne lagte hain. Aayatan par shulk ka girna, niryat ka zyada takatvar hona tatha niryat matra ka badhna is badhotri ke sahi sanket nahi hain. Yah teeno vikalp galti se laabh batate hain. Exam point: REER ka badhna niryat ki takat ke liye buri khabar hai, kyunki desi maal mehnga ho jaata hai.

qe: The 'Gross National Happiness' (GNH) index was first introduced by which country in 1972?
qh: 1972 में 'ग्रॉस नेशनल हैप्पीनेस' (GNH) सूचकांक सबसे पहले किस देश द्वारा पेश किया गया था?
e: Gross National Happiness yaani kul rastriya khushi ka soochak 1972 mein Bhutan ne sabse pehle pesh kiya, isliye yah desh bhautik vikas ke saath logon ki khushi ko bhi paimana banata hai. Doosra vikalp Bhutan ko sahi pehla desh batata hai. Yah soch isliye wahan aage aayi ki raja ne keval kamai ke peeche bhaagne ki jagah dono lene tatha rehne ke star ko samvedansheel maana, isliye yah soochak duniya bhar mein prasiddh hua. Bharat, Norway tatha Switzerland is soochak ke sahi pehle desh nahi hain, kyunki ye anya vikas ke raste apnate rahe. Yah teeno vikalp is soochak ke janm se nahi jude. Exam point: GNH yaani kul rastriya khushi ka soochak sabse pehle 1972 mein Bhutan ne pesh kiya tha.

qe: The 'Gross National Happiness Index' (GNH) includes which of the following dimensions?
qh: 'ग्रॉस नेशनल हैप्पीनेस इंडेक्स' (GNH) में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा आयाम शामिल है?
e: GNH soochak mein tikau vikas, susashan tatha paryavaran raksha tatha sanskritik mulyo - sabhi aayam shaamil hote hain, isliye yah keval ek paimana nahi balki khushi ke kai pehluon ko jodta hai. Teesra vikalp inhi sabhi aayam ko sahi jodta hai. Aise kaee aayam isliye rakhe gaye ki khushi keval paise se nahi aati, isliye swasthya, padhai, susashan tatha sanskriti ko bhi barabar jagah milti hai. Keval tikau vikas, keval susashan tatha keval paryavaran raksha tatha sanskritik mulya - ye teeno adhure roop hain, poori soochi nahi. Yah teeno vikalp soochak ke kuch hisse maatra hain. Exam point: GNH mein tikau vikas, susashan tatha paryavaran tatha sanskriti - sabhi aayam gine jaate hain.
